recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. If checked-in generated artifacts are refreshed later, source/specimen/specimen.svg should be regenerated rather than hand-edited to pick up the new tooltip text.
issue_request: FHIR-22823 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request to support nested specimen containers, remove the old direct-container wording, and use a Specimen.container Device reference whose parent Device represents holders.
initial_application: The original PR #1889 history, including Jira-linked commit 29192683e49ddd240fe9cf6620eaf7c80f2104e4 and structural commit 4d596144595f5c42835f097054592c5fffb8babd, removed Specimen.container.identifier/description/type and added Specimen.container.device. Current active source still retained stale StructureDefinition and introduction wording saying the container was direct and recursive containers were not addressed.
additional_context: OO meeting minutes and Zulip discussion support the Device-based holder/storage model. Later FHIR-36029 and FHIR-40559 work continued moving container attributes and location to Device-backed modeling rather than restoring direct Specimen.container fields.
reconciliation: Updated source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml and source/specimen/specimen-introduction.xml to describe nesting through Specimen.container.device[x] and, for referenced Device instances, Device.parent and Device.location.
source_changes: source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: removed stale Direct/unsupported-recursion wording from Specimen.container and pointed nesting to referenced Device.parent.
source/specimen/specimen-introduction.xml: replaced the obsolete statement that recursive containers/location tracking are not addressed with current Device-based guidance.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue added Specimen.container.location; later FHIR-22823/FHIR-40559 context shifted location to the container Device.
Later Published issue moved additional container attributes from Specimen.container to Device-backed modeling and already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
Later Applied issue removed Specimen.container.location because Specimen.container.device.location carries location information.
